resolution.note: successor-launch --unattended refuses on failed doctor (launcher tests); watchdog handles a StopFailure payload (watchdog tests); settings.json StopFailure wiring left to the lead

title: An unattended lead that dies on quota or an API error is restarted, and successor launch runs the unattended doctor first
body:
Why: Fable audit 1114f (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-audit-1114f.md) missing: no watchdog, no StopFailure hook, quota rule is prose (goal.md:18); krn doctor unattended is in no steering.
Outcome: a StopFailure/watchdog path relaunches a successor from the newest handoff (switching cswap account when 5h > 85%); successor-launch refuses an unattended launch when doctor --unattended fails.
Proof: launcher test: failed doctor exits non-zero; watchdog test with a captured StopFailure payload.
